articles.title: PREVIEW: Detroit, Winnipeg set to square off in Sunday matinee
NHL/NHLPA Industry Growth Fund, Red Wings donate Zamboni to Michigan rink
Senators look to win two straight to begin a season for first time in 10 years

away.summary: The Ottawa Senators are looking to start the season with two straight wins for the first time in 10 years. They have a strong lineup with returning players like Thomas Chabot and Claude Giroux, and Cam Crotty is set to replace the injured Jake Sanderson on the blueline. Linus Ullmark is confirmed to start in goal, and the team is focused on building off their strong performance in their season opener against the Toronto Maple Leafs.

home.summary: The Detroit Red Wings are looking to build on their defensive performance from their season opener while converting more scoring chances. They are missing key players like Charlie McAvoy, who is suspended, and Marco Kasper, who is out due to an upper body injury. The team is expected to rely on their returning players and new additions to find more offense, with Lucas Raymond emphasizing the importance of sustained pressure and creating more scoring chances.
